# Business Insider

> > Business Insider delivers global business news, market analysis, and financial intelligence across equities, commodities, and currencies.

Business Insider is a leading digital media company providing real-time market data, premarket trading information, and comprehensive coverage of major global indices including S&P 500, NASDAQ 100, DOW JONES, and international markets like FTSE 100, DAX, and NIKKEI 225. The platform serves investors, traders, and business professionals with financial news, market analysis, and advertising solutions.

## Key Topics

- S&P 500
- NASDAQ 100
- DOW JONES
- Premarket Trading
- Stock Futures
- Global Market Indices
- FTSE 100
- DAX
- Real-time Quotes
- Financial News
- Market Analysis
- Currency Exchange
- Commodity Futures
- Investment Strategy
- Economic Outlook

## Market Data & Trading

- [Premarket | Futures | Pre-market Trading | Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket): Real-time premarket quotes for DOW JONES, NASDAQ 100, S&P 500, and more
- [US Dollar Index | Global Market Indices | International Markets | Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/us-dollar-index): US Dollar Index (DXY) data, historical prices, and performance metrics

## Financial News & Analysis

- [News | Financial and Business News | Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/news): Latest financial news and analysis on stocks, indices, and commodities

## Regional Coverage

- [Business Insider Africa](https://africa.businessinsider.com/): Regional hub for African business, sports, and lifestyle news
